channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from PNallDR, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: DeSantis backs Florida GOP ticket including Donalds for governor
item.description: Governor Ron DeSantis endorsed a group of Republican candidates, including gubernatorial hopeful Byron Donalds.

item.title: Massachusetts Democrats back Markey over Moulton in primary
item.description: Incumbent Ed Markey, 80, defeated challenger Seth Moulton, who had urged generational change in the party.

item.title: Comer tells Newsmax ending birth tourism is key GOP goal
item.description: Representative James Comer of Kentucky stated that House Republicans prioritize ending birth tourism.

item.title: Texas Democrat raises funds in Hollywood amid GOP Dallas rally
item.description: James Talarico holds a second celebrity fundraiser while Republicans gather in Dallas with Ken Paxton and Trump.
